meta.description: Share the wedding site, upload your photos and videos, and help Austin and Jordyn keep the day alive from every angle.

navLinks.text: Watch the film Revisit the ceremony, speeches, and the whole dance floor arc.
Browse the gallery Portraits, candids, and every little detail we never want to forget.
Leave a note A quiet last stop for one message, blessing, or little memory from the day.
Memory Book Print a keepsake photo book or guestbook — save as PDF from any browser.

mainText: Preserve the moments from your perspective.
Phone photos, shaky dance-floor videos, ceremony candids, quiet table moments: the whole archive gets better when your side of the day is part of it too.
Claim ownership of your uploaded photos or face clusters you appear in. Get your name verified and beautifully displayed in gold italics across the gallery.
Drop photos or videos to begin.
Click anywhere or drag your files in
Tell us who this upload came from.
We only need enough information to credit the memories and send you a quick note when they are approved.
We keep this in case we need to reach you about your photos.
Only Austin & Jordyn can see these until they are approved.
Uploads stay in review until we sort and caption them for the gallery.
Your contact details stay with the submission in case we need context while reviewing it.
Duplicates and oversized files are called out before submission so the queue stays honest.
You can submit once at least one file is marked ready and your contact details are filled in. Files that failed will stay out until you retry or remove them.

After you send, the upload enters a private review queue. Approved photos can be published into the live gallery, while approved video clips can be kept private, added to guest highlights, or featured later.
Send the full site to anyone who still has not watched or browsed yet.
These buttons share the site itself. Uploads still happen separately above.
